title: Fluvv project file
description: Optional `fluvv.yaml` at a repository's root: marks the root and names its top-level folders when they aren't the defaults. See docs/fluvv/SPEC.md Section 1.1.

contracts.description: The folder holding the contracts, relative to this file. Default: contracts.

governance.description: The folder holding the governance files, relative to this file. Default: governance.

Folder.description: A folder inside the repository: not absolute, and with no `.` or `..` in it.
